description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought by paying {1}.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters the battlefield, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Dreadnought's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Dreadnought trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
